image_prompts.prompt: A senior cybersecurity analyst sitting in a sterile, high-tech office at night. The room is illuminated only by the cool blue light of massive computer monitors reflecting in her focused, tired eyes.

Close-up of a computer monitor displaying a wall of scrolling green and blue code. A single digit on the screen is highlighted in a jarring, bright red color, causing a slight frown on the analyst's face.
A montage-style shot of a woman looking increasingly agitated in front of multiple screens. The room is filled with chaotic, flickering data streams and harsh, clinical lighting.
Extreme close-up of a woman's face in a dark room, illuminated by the harsh, cold blue glow of a monitor. The screen displays the text 'IDENTITY NOT FOUND' in stark, clinical white letters.
An apartment turned into a messy, high-tech command center with wires snaking across surfaces. A woman sits in the center, surrounded by glowing screens, looking determined and paranoid.
Multiple computer screens displaying complex, alien-looking network topology diagrams and obfuscated code. The room is cast in cold, impersonal blue and green light.
A woman sitting in a dark room, looking over her shoulder with a sense of dread. The shadows are deep and oppressive, with only faint, flickering light from a computer monitor.
Dawn light filtering through window blinds into a dark apartment, mixing with the harsh glow of computer monitors. Complex network diagrams are visible on the screens.
A computer screen showing a faded, vintage photograph of a woman next to modern government-level data files. The lighting is stark and clinical, highlighting the shock on the protagonist's face.
A woman sitting alone in a dark, messy apartment, looking at a screen that reveals her identity has been stolen. Her face is pale and desaturated, reflecting the horror of her reality collapsing.
A woman in a sharp suit sitting alone in a massive, sterile executive conference room. The room is dimly lit with harsh overhead fluorescent lights, casting long, stark shadows.
A woman sitting on her floor, surrounded by multiple screens flickering with static and conflicting data. The room is dark, cold, and claustrophobic.
A massive, subterranean server farm with endless rows of humming, glowing server racks. The lighting is cold, clinical, and industrial, emphasizing the immense scale of the facility.
A woman standing in the center of her apartment, looking exhausted and paranoid. The room is filled with shadows and the cold, blue light of screens.
Close-up of a woman's face, looking deeply distressed and isolated in a dark room. The light from a computer monitor casts sharp, high-contrast shadows on her skin.
A completely black screen, signifying a transition into the past.

video_prompts.prompt: Slow gimbal tracking shot moving past server racks toward Elena, who is typing rhythmically at her desk.
A tight, handheld follow shot of Elena's eyes scanning lines of code, focusing on a single blinking red character.
Rapid, rhythmic cuts between Elena's face and flickering screens, getting progressively faster to show mounting panic.
A very slow, deliberate zoom into Elena's face as the 'IDENTITY NOT FOUND' text appears on her screen.
A handheld, slightly shaky shot moving around Elena's apartment to show the chaotic, makeshift command center.
Quick cuts between complex, geometric network diagrams and Elena's tightening jaw.
A slow, unsettling pan around the room, catching glimpses of shadows that seem to move.
A wide shot slowly zooming into a monitor displaying a complex network topology, with dawn light creeping in.
A slow pull-back from a monitor showing a dead woman's photo to reveal Elena's face in the dark bezel.
A slow, creeping push-in on Elena's eyes as they reflect the distorted images on her screen.
A slow pull-back from a tight shot of Elena to reveal the vast, empty conference room around her.
A slow, oppressive push toward Elena as she sits motionless amidst the flickering screens.
A wide, sweeping drone shot over the vast, cold, and desolate interior of the subterranean server farm.
A slow pan across a room filled with screens, ending on Elena sitting in total darkness.
A slow, clinical push-in on Elena, who stares blankly at a wall of code.
A static, black screen that slowly fades out to nothing.

youtube_metadata.title: The Ghost in the Machine: Shadow Protocol Case 001
youtube_metadata.description: Elena Vasquez, a brilliant cybersecurity analyst, discovers her identity has been systematically erased and replaced by a ghost from the past. In this premiere episode of Shadow Protocol, we descend into the deep state, digital espionage, and the terrifying reality of a surveillance system that knows you better than you know yourself. Are you who you think you are?

thumbnail_prompt.prompt: High contrast, shadow-heavy shot of a woman's face illuminated by the harsh, cold blue glow of a computer monitor. The background is pitch black, and the only accent color is a single, bright red digit on the screen in the foreground.
